headline: 131 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Little Giant Fire in WA, threatening 6,010 structures.

active_threats.name: Little Giant
active_threats.narrative: The Little Giant Fire in Chelan County, WA has burned 138,474 acres and is 12% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **6,010 structures threatened**. 1,854 personnel are assigned. emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over FL: Miami city, Port St. Lucie city, Cape Coral city, Fort Lauderdale city, and Pembroke Pines city and 12 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 14% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
